title: Challenges in Multitouch Interface Design: Bridging Natural and Digital Interaction
content: Multitouch interfaces offer a direct user experience, but designing them presents significant challenges. This paper ex- plores the limitations of current multitouch screens, particularly in representing 3D interactions. It discusses the conflict between natural physical gestures and the artificiality of screen-based interactions, analyzing the difficulties in creating truly ’natural’ user interfaces. The paper emphasizes the need to address these challenges to improve the effectiveness of multitouch technology.
